provider.description: The resource provider namespace of the resources being validated

type.description: The type of the resources being validated

location.description: The optional location for the resources being validated

scope.description: The scope of the resources being validated

resources.description:
The list of resources to validate. Each resource in the list must have the same namespace, type, and location.
The namespace and type on each resource must match the corresponding values in the top-level request.
The location on each resource must match the top-level location in the request if specified.

validationType.description: The type of resource validation to perform

performPreflightWithoutRbacWriteCheck.description: If true, the validation will be performed without checking RBAC write permissions.

apiVersion.description: The API version to use with this resource.

onlyIfNotExists.description: Set this to true if this resource is meant to be provisioned only if it does not exist.

properties.description: Details about the results of the validation

validatedResources.description: List of ARM resource IDs corresponding to the resources that were successfully validated
